import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from harness import *
def I(payload,pn=0,ann=0,token=b'',tokw=None,lenw=None,width=4,dcid=b'\xaa',scid=b'\xbb'):
    tl = v(len(token),width=tokw) if tokw else v(len(token))
    ln = v(width+len(payload),width=lenw) if lenw else v(width+len(payload))
    return datagram(bytes([0xc0|(width-1)])+b'\0\0\0\1'+bytes([len(dcid)])+dcid+bytes([len(scid)])+scid+tl+token+ln+pn.to_bytes(width,'big')+payload,[ann])
# overlong token length narrowed
t=one(trace([{'keys':['I']}, I(b'\x01',0,token=b'\x01\x02\x03',tokw=2)]))
exp=bytes([0xc0])+b'\0\0\0\1'+b'\x01\xaa'+b'\x01\xbb'+v(3)+b'\x01\x02\x03'+v(2)+b'\x00'+b'\x01'
check('token-narrow',(t['packets'][0]['status'],t['packets'][0]['sha256']),('OK',sha(exp)))
# overlong length narrowed with token
t=one(trace([{'keys':['I']}, I(b'\x01',0,token=b'\x01\x02\x03',lenw=2)]))
exp=bytes([0xc0])+b'\0\0\0\1'+b'\x01\xaa'+b'\x01\xbb'+v(3)+b'\x01\x02\x03'+v(2)+b'\x00'+b'\x01'
check('len-narrow-token',(t['packets'][0]['sha256']),sha(exp))
# empty token stays empty
t=one(trace([{'keys':['I']}, I(b'\x01',0)]))
exp=bytes([0xc0])+b'\0\0\0\1'+b'\x01\xaa'+b'\x01\xbb'+v(0)+v(2)+b'\x00'+b'\x01'
check('token-empty',(t['packets'][0]['sha256']),sha(exp))
# 20 byte dcid and scid
dcid=bytes(range(20)); scid=bytes(range(20,40))
t=one(trace([{'keys':['I']}, I(b'\x01',0,dcid=dcid,scid=scid)]))
check('cid20',t['packets'][0]['status'],'DROP_CID')
# dcid within local cids (register with matching cid)
cids=tuple([dcid.hex()])
t=one(trace([{'keys':['I']}, I(b'\x01',0,dcid=dcid,scid=scid)],local_cids=cids))
exp=bytes([0xc0])+b'\0\0\0\1'+bytes([20])+dcid+bytes([20])+scid+v(0)+v(2)+b'\x00'+b'\x01'
check('cid20-ok',(t['packets'][0]['status'],t['packets'][0]['sha256']),('OK',sha(exp)))
# short header with 20-byte local cid width
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, datagram(bytes([0x40|3])+dcid+(0).to_bytes(4,'big')+b'\x01',[0])],local_cids=cids))
check('short-20',t['packets'][0]['status'],'OK')
# non-minimal type byte in payload of A packet
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, datagram(bytes([0x40])+dcid[:1]+b'\x00'+b'\x41\x01',[0])],local_cids=cids[:1]))
check('nonminimal-A',t['packets'][0]['status'],'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR')
print('failures:',len(FAILURES))
EOF
